name: Maya Ortiz
title: Software Engineer
tagline: Maya Ortiz builds systems that stay up at 3am.
heroDescription: Six years designing and operating backend platforms — from payment infrastructure serving millions of requests a day to internal tools that make other engineers faster. I care about correctness, clear interfaces, and systems that fail loudly instead of quietly.
aboutDescription: I'm a software engineer who started out fixing bugs in a university robotics lab and ended up falling in love with the unglamorous parts of engineering: queues, retries, migrations, the stuff that has to work even when nobody's watching.
pullQuote: Good infrastructure is invisible when it works and instantly diagnosable when it doesn't.
